name: @vigilia/fake-source
description: Deterministic synthetic sample source for developing and testing the display path without a host.
//: DEV AND TEST ONLY. This is not a provider: providers acquire hardware data on the PC and live in src/Vigilia.Providers.*. This package fabricates samples so the renderer, themes and the player can be developed before the SignalR transport exists. It must never be a dependency of a shipped player or editor bundle — if it appears in one, the display is showing invented numbers, which §97 forbids.
